sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, gp.SalesPrice AS salesPrice, gp.RetailPrice AS retailPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile spp ON spp.PortalId = po.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeProfile spf ON spf.ProfileId = spp.ProfileId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pl.PriceListId, pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice, COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = spp.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @profileListRank ELSE @storeListRank END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 mav.AttributeValue AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue mpv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute mpa ON mpa.PimAttributeId = mpv.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale mav ON mav.PimAttributeValueId = mpv.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale mlo ON mlo.LocaleId = mav.LocaleId WHERE mpv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND mpa.AttributeCode = @maxQuantityCode AND mlo.IsDefault = @defaultLocale ORDER BY mpv.PimAttributeValueId, mav.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocaleId) mq WHERE spf.ProfileName = @profile AND p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) >= @quantityUsed AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (TRY_CAST(mq.val AS FLOAT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(mq.val AS FLOAT) >= @quantityUsed) AND gp.SalesPrice > @minPrice AND gp.SalesPrice < gp.RetailPrice AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT dp.PromotionId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotion dp WHERE (dp.PortalId IS NULL OR dp.PortalId = po.PortalId) AND (dp.IsCouponRequired IS NULL OR dp.IsCouponRequired = @couponNotRequired) AND (dp.StartDate IS NULL OR dp.StartDate <= @now) AND (dp.EndDate IS NULL OR dp.EndDate >= @now) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT dn.PromotionProfileMapperId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProfileMapper dn WHERE dn.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId) OR EXISTS (SELECT dm.PromotionProfileMapperId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProfileMapper dm LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeProfile df ON df.ProfileId = dm.ProfileId WHERE dm.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND (dm.ProfileId IS NULL OR df.ProfileName = @profile))) AND (EXISTS (SELECT dpp.PromotionProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProduct dpp WHERE dpp.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND dpp.PublishProductId = p.PimProductId) OR EXISTS (SELECT dce.PublishCategoryEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionCategory dpc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity dce ON dce.ZnodeCategoryId = dpc.PublishCategoryId WHERE dpc.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, p.PimProductId, @comma), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(dce.ProductIds, @openBracket, @comma), @closeBracket, @comma), @space, @comma)) > @zero) OR EXISTS (SELECT dcp.PimCategoryProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionCategory dhc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy dch ON dch.PimCategoryHierarchyId = dhc.PublishCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct dcp ON dcp.PimCategoryId = dch.PimCategoryId WHERE dhc.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND dcp.PimProductId = p.PimProductId))) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
